items.title: Akka 在 65 个开源项目中测试基于规格的 AI 交付
items.raw_excerpt: Akka 利用 65 个开源项目，对一种基于规格说明的 AI 辅助软件移植工作流进行了 测试 ，评估内容包括：规格说明的结构、上下文、模型和工作量选择、自动化验证、token 消耗以及运行时性能。首轮测试耗时 99.3 小时，消耗了 94.1 亿个令牌。根据 Akka 的报告，在 65 个移植项目中，有 57 个在代码行数或性能方面实现了提升。

items.title: Twain, a diff viewer like Meld, but for the age of AI
items.raw_excerpt:
I love Meld, I've been using it for a while now, it's amazing how many diff viewers exist these days and how they are all awful compared to Meld. But Meld was missing some features that I thought were worth having: - all files from a Git diff shown in the same view, sequentially + a file tree on the side.
- show either the full files or only the parts that changed.
- tree-sitter-based syntax highlighting.
- the ability to comment on sets of changes and lines, and AIs can read these comments.
- the ability to search through the entire set of modified files. Twain is in Rust and based on GTK4.

items.title: This implant can restore sight for patients with macular degeneration
items.raw_excerpt: More than 5 million people around the world with age-related macular degeneration (AMD) experience atrophy in their retinas. And until now, no treatment could restore their vision. The PRIMA system, which was approved in Europe in July and is awaiting FDA clearance in the US, changes that. It combines a retinal implant with camera-­equipped eyeglasses…
